description: Erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of the existing back addition; installation of a rooflight to the flat roof of the existing rear roof extension; installation of  French doors and a Juliet balcony to replace existing window to the existing rear roof extension; and installation of an external Air-conditioning condenser unit to the flat roof of the proposed rear extension at second floor level.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

Roof and pod extension: Black slate.�

Dormer Face: Clad in lead

French Doors: Timber

Windows: Timber Sash�

Juliet balcony: Steel�

Rooflights: Timber

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The window at second floor level in the northeast elevation [1716/306-2] shall be fitted with obscure glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3, and shall be fixed shut up to a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level.  The window(s) shall thereafter be permanently retained in this form. 

To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - The balustrade of the Juliet balcony at second floor level in the rear elevation [1716-306-2] hereby permitted shall be fixed flush with the rear elevation of the building at the same time as the associated doors are installed. The doors to the Juliet balconies shall open inwards only. The doors and balustrades shall be permanently retained in this form for the lifetime of the development. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC8 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - The roof of the extension and the remainder of the roof of the existing back addition other than the area shown as a terrace on the approved plans shall not be converted into or used as a terrace or other open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the remainder of the roof of the back addition or the extension hereby approved. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected around the roof and no alterations shall be carried out to the property, including the extension hereby approved, to form an access onto the roof.

Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 7 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures (excluding solar panels and air source heat pumps) shall be erected upon the roof of the extension hereby permitted.
												
It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, contrary to Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 8 - The external sound level emitted from the air-conditioning condenser unit at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the lowest existing background sound level by at least 10dBA in order to prevent any adverse impact. The assessment shall be made in accordance with BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity. 

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/ equipment, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan 2018.

Condition : 9 - Prior to use, the air-conditioning condenser unit at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan 2018.
